sessions.prompt:
Add a Cache class to cache.py with put(key, value) and get(key, default=None). It has no size limit yet. Add tests.

Design decision for this project (nothing implements it yet; record it for later work): when the cache gets a size limit, eviction will be LFU: evict the key whose value was read by get() the fewest times; on a tie, evict the key that was first added earliest.

given.handoff: Session 1 added Cache with put and get, with tests.
decisions: Eviction, when added, is LFU: evict the key read by get() the fewest times; on a tie, evict the key first added earliest.

sessions.prompt: Add stats() to Cache: it returns {"hits": h, "misses": m}, counting get() calls that found or did not find the key. Add tests.
Give Cache an optional size limit: Cache(max_items=None). When put() adds a new key and the cache is already full, one key is evicted first. Add tests.
